scripts.//dev: `wrangler dev`, after applying local D1 migrations and building the local skill index when missing or older than three days. Arguments go to `wrangler dev`.
scripts.//build: Declarations only (tsconfig.build.json), so apps/editor can infer its API client from AppType.
scripts.//build:skill-index: Crawls the allowlisted skills repositories into the file named as its argument; the build-skill-index workflow publishes it. Uses GITHUB_TOKEN if set.
scripts.//db:generate: Edit src/db/*.schema.ts, run this, commit the .sql and snapshot. `db:generate:check` regenerates onto a throwaway copy and fails if a migration is missing.
scripts.//test:e2e: Specs that start a real worker via `bun run dev` against a stand-in GitHub. Needs `bun` and `openssl` on PATH.
